description: Token.content is a tracking token (a JWT in the spec's example), typed as a plain string. Only createInstanceToken returns it, as `Token` rather than `TokenMetadata`. STACKIT's docs say its value is shown once and not stored (docs.stackit.cloud/products/data-and-ai/ai-model-experiments/faq/, read 2026-11-01), and its Terraform provider marks it Sensitive (stackit/internal/services/modelexperiments/token/resource.go, read 2026-11-01).
